title: A canvas only while something moves
blurb: Two copies of one card with the same transition. One lives in a canvas all the time. The other is plain HTML, and is moved into a canvas made on the spot for the length of the transition. The page measures what each costs.
question: Does an element have to live in a canvas all the time to get a canvas transition, or can the canvas be made when the transition starts and removed when it ends?
result: It can be made on the spot. Moving the card in with moveBefore() kept focus on the pressed button, and the first frame of the transition came no later than with a permanent canvas (33 ms after the press for both, in a software browser). At rest the card is plain HTML and no canvas memory is held.
